dataList.content:
This staircase descended for much longer than we had anticipated. We couldn't even guess how far we were from the bottom.
我原以为只要向下稍微走一段路就能抵达底部，但没想到这楼梯却显得像是没有尽头一般。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Basement Stairs
呼啸山庄 地下室楼梯

dataList.content:
Is there even an end to these stairs...?
这段楼梯难道没有尽头的吗……？

I wonder if this depth was really that necessary? The servants must've had quite the hard time putting these stairs together.
真的有必要建造得如此深入吗？佣人们肯定费了好一番功夫。

If they operate under the identical mechanisms as our corridor, then there is a chance that they may not have been installed by hand.
也可能不是一个个手工建成的。若是与走廊相同的原理……

There is a dark look on Sinclair's face.
辛克莱的表情并不明朗。

... This is a grim reminder of our experience back in the basement of his mansion.
……也许是因为我们曾有过在类似的空间中向下进发的经历。

This is... exactly what the basement at my home felt like.
这里的氛围……简直与我家的地下室如出一辙。

<Sinclair, what happened back then... it still haunts you, doesn't it?>
<那时的种种仍困扰着你吗？……辛克莱。>

Can't say that I've completely moved on from it...
我还是无法否定……

But... I'm moving forward, little... by little.
但我应该还是有在一点点地……向前迈进。

<... Yeah. I can clearly see that.>
<……嗯。我也那么认为。>

... That's good. Sometimes, I'm not sure if I'm just imagining that I'm getting better.
……太好了。我还以为只有自己在那么想。

A sudden yet familiar sensation tickles my head.
一阵熟悉的感觉直击我的大脑。

It is soon followed by a noise just as familiar.
紧接着，传来了一阵我确信自己耳熟的声音。

The unpleasant sound of something approaching, dragging itself across the floor...
以令人不悦的声音抓挠着地板奔来的……

No... crawling...
不对，爬来的是……

Something's crawling this way... It can't be an Abnormality, can it? At a place like this?
感觉有什么东西正爬过来……难道是，异想体吗？在这种地方？

<No, this is... it's gotta be...>
<不……这应该是……>

The Peccatula.
是罪种们。

However, this place does not appear to be the Lobotomy Corp. branch, nor does it appear to be connected to one as Sinclair's mansion was.
我判断此处既不是脑叶公司支部，也不像是辛克莱的宅邸中那种与支部相连的通道。

Correct. The L Corp. branch in T Corp. is a fair distance away from this manor.
正是如此。位于T公司的支部与此处相隔甚远。

Causeless effects. I fail to see why this is happening.
知其然而不知其所以然。

As always, even in seemingly inexplicable circumstances such as this, laws of causality remain constant. There is always a cause to an effect.
一如既往，即便是在看似无法理解的情况下，因果法则仍旧有效，有果必有因。

... Understood.
……了解。

Well...
哎……

I guess we'll find out what that 'cause' is at the end of this stairwell.
当我们抵达地下室的尽头时，就能知道原因了吧。
